    • setRateWindow

      public final void setRateWindow(org.wpilib.units.measure.Time rateWindow)
      Sets the duration used to calculate the encoder rate.

      The duration must be between 5 and 255 milliseconds, inclusive. It is rounded to the nearest millisecond to match the resolution supported by WPILib.

      Parameters:
      rateWindow - rate calculation window
